text:
That is unexpected; the normal inflammatory markers and urinalysis make a typical infectious arthritis or vasculitis less likely. Given your age, fever, severe leg pain, and easy bruising, could you tell me if you have had any recent joint swelling or morning stiffness?

REQUEST TEST: Ferritin, Fibrinogen, and D-dimer
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hemorrhagic Edema of Infancy (considering age and bruising) or early Leukemia (despite normal inflammatory markers, need to rule out malignancy).
